mapper.insert: insert into sessions (id, user_id, tenant_id, expires_at, agent, band) values (#{id}, cast(#{uid} as uuid), #{tid}, now() + make_interval(mins => #{min}), #{agent}, #{band})
mapper.delete: delete from sessions where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and id in (select id from sessions where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and expires_at > now() order by created_at desc, id offset #{keep})
mapper.select: select email from users where id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
select count(*)::int from sessions where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and id <> #{id} and expires_at > now() and created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => #{maxH})

select s.id sid, u.id::text uid, u.email, u.role, u.pw_temp, t.id tid, t.name, t.type, t.mode, extract(epoch from s.expires_at - now())::float8 remain from sessions s join users u on u.id = s.user_id join tenants t on t.id = s.tenant_id where s.id = #{id} and s.expires_at > now() and s.created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => #{maxH})
mapper.update: update sessions set expires_at = least(created_at + make_interval(hours => #{maxH}), greatest(now() + make_interval(mins => #{idle}), coalesce(work_until, now()))), last_at = now() where id = #{id}
update sessions set work_until = null, work_reason = null where id = #{id}
update sessions set work_until = least(created_at + make_interval(hours => #{maxH}), now() + make_interval(mins => #{min})), work_reason = #{reason}, last_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, agent, band, to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') c, to_char(last_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') l, to_char(expires_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') e from sessions where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and expires_at > now() and created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => #{maxH}) order by last_at desc, created_at desc limit 50
mapper.delete: delete from sessions where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and id <> #{id}
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = jsonb_set(doc, '{org,sec}', coalesce(doc->'org'->'sec', '{}'::jsonb) || cast(#{json} as jsonb)) where tenant_id = #{tid} and jsonb_typeof(doc->'org') = 'object'
